subject: Alpine pilot — post-demo recap, recommended engine slate and decision gates

Subject: Alpine pilot — post-demo recap, recommended engine slate and decision gates

Hi Maya — thanks again for taking the demo today. Appreciated the candid walkthrough of the ingestion patterns and your latency targets. Quick recap and next steps from our side: 

What we heard
- Primary workload: multi-turn summarization + fact extraction for enterprise support tickets (avg req size 400 tokens; occasional bursts to 2.5k).
- SLO: 95th percentile under 600ms for short requests; acceptable tail up to 1.2s on heavier ones.
- Cost sensitivity: target <$0.12 per 1k tokens for production reads.
- Security: SOC2 required, VPC/private deployment likely for pilot.

Recommended pilot slate (first pass) — highlights only; full bench linked below
1) Redwood-4xQ (8-bit quant) — quality: high on long-context summarization, latency: mid, cost: best for throughput due to quantization.
2) Lumen-13B (FP16) — quality: strong factuality; latency higher but consistent; good fallback when precision matters.
3) Compact-7B-INT8 — low cost, very fast; acceptable on short-form extraction but weaker on long coherent summarization.

Attachments & links: I attached the prompt-pack and the benchmark CSV we discussed. Full benchmark sheets and prompt sets are in the Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1AlpinePilotEval

Immediate asks / decision gates
- Confirm pilot target (throughput and duration) so we can size Dedicated capacity and pricing.
- Pick one model for the initial canary (we recommend Redwood-4xQ).
- Approve extraction prompt set and 50-case regression suite for quality monitoring.

Next steps
- If you agree, we’ll provision a 1-week canary with the Redwood-4xQ config and share a regression dashboard within 48 hrs of run start.

Thanks — I’ll loop in Marissa on cost/commercials once we have target throughput.

Best,
Ben Carter

Subject: Re: Alpine pilot — commercial + candidate slate (summary)

Ben / team — see concise slate below plus commercial sketch and operational notes. Attaching a short PDF with side-by-side numbers (pilot_commercial_options.pdf) and the CSV benchmark summary.

Priority recommended slate (ranked)
1) Redwood-4xQ (canary pick)
- Rationale: best balance of coherent long-form summarization and token cost when quantized. Our sample runs show 95p latency ~620ms on the Dedicated medium pool and per-1k token cost ~ $0.095 in pilot sizing (includes infra + token compute).
- Risks / mitigations: marginally higher token hallucination risk vs FP16 on rare factual probes — mitigate with extraction-layer rules and targeted regression cases.
2) Lumen-13B (precision fallback)
- Rationale: strongest factuality for extraction tasks; 95p latency ~980ms; per-1k token cost ~ $0.18. Use as fallback for requests failing QA checks.
3) Compact-7B-INT8 (scale option)
- Rationale: lowest cost (~$0.045 per 1k tokens), 95p latency ~380ms, good for high-throughput extraction only. Not recommended for final summarization outputs.

Operational recommendations
- Canary plan: 72-hour canary with Redwood-4xQ on a Dedicated medium pool, route 5% of traffic initially, step to 25% at 24h if no regressions, 100% after 72h. Failure criteria: degrade in rouge/f1 on regression suite >4% relative or error rate spike >1.5x baseline.
- Regression suite: run 50-case set (provided in alpine_pilot_prompt_pack.zip) every 6 hours during canary; automated alerts to SLO channel.
- KV cache & batching: configure dynamic batching with max batch latency 25ms, KV cache sized to hold 8 active sessions per replica given your 2.5k token tails.

Commercial sketch
- Pilot estimate (2 weeks, expected token volume ~4M tokens): Redwood-4xQ pilot cost estimate ~$380 (infrastructure) + token compute included in per-1k estimate above. Detailed numbers in attached PDF.

Next steps to send customer
- One-page commercial summary (I’ll draft now).
- Security packet (SOC2 artifacts and VPC deployment guide) — Monica to own.
- Confirm pilot start date — propose next Tue 2027-06-14.

Marissa
